title: NEW MSFS 2024 Activities: 80-Flight World Tour, Australia & JetBlue Missions!
description:
If you're looking to take your visual exploration and route flying to the next level in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, the marketplace just rolled out a massive wave of curated discovery flights, global expeditions, and structured airline missions. From flying scheduled narrow-body airline operations along US commercial corridors to embarking on an 80-leg world circumnavigation, island hopping across Hawaii, and touring the vast Australian Outback, this drop brings hours of guided flying adventures.

In this comprehensive activity breakdown, we organize this week's marketplace arrivals into clear categories to help you decide what's claiming top priority in your flight log:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE OPERATIONS
We kick off with Perfect Flight's America 250 series featuring JetBlue Airways, designed specifically for the iniBuilds Airbus A320 V2. This package bundles an authentic JetBlue livery alongside 12 scheduled IFR missions packed with monitored event scenarios, realistic airline audio, and full compatibility with third-party add-on scenery.

🌍 GLOBAL EXPEDITIONS & ISLAND ESCAPES
Looking for epic long-range touring? We inspect Koschi’s massive "Around the World in 80 Flights" expedition in the Beechcraft King Air 350i, guiding you across 559 waypoints, 156 handcrafted POIs, and 21 areas of interest. Then, we head into the Pacific for Koschi’s Beautiful Hawaii Mission Pack, covering 6 main islands with 3 discovery flights, 3 authentic landing challenges (including Hana and Honolulu), and a 7-leg, 600+ nautical mile bush trip supported by over 200 narrated audio tips.

🇦🇺 THE AUSTRALIA: ALL SIGHTS SERIES (KOSCHI)
For rugged outback explorers, we evaluate Koschi's comprehensive Australia: All Sights collection. We look at the complete multi-part bundle covering the Top End, Simpson Desert, Uluru (Ayers Rock), the Gold Coast, Bass Strait crossing into Tasmania, and out into the remote Mitchell Plateau—and we break down why picking up the complete bundle offers far better value than buying individual legs.

🇩🇪 DISCOVER GERMANY VFR TOURS (KOSCHI)
We wrap up across Western Europe with Koschi’s Discover Germany series (Parts 1, 2, and 3), now ported to MSFS 2024. Flying the Garmin G1000-equipped Cessna 172 Skyhawk, these multi-leg VFR tours guide you along hundreds of miles of scenic German countryside, historic cities, and routes tracing right along the Dutch border.

Which of these new activities or mission packs are you loading up first? Are you tackling the 80-flight circumnavigation, flying scheduled JetBlue routes in the A320, or exploring the Australian Outback? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you find your next flight adventure in MSFS 2024, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and blue skies on your next flight!
